scope: Proposition 5.10 (Starting pair measures) of the manuscript “The Falconer distance conjecture in all dimensions” (preprints/The-Falconer-distance-conjecture-in-all-dimensions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 073 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 98a7e721547308b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let E ⊂ Rd be compact, d ≥ 2, and dimH E > S = d/2. Either Lemma 5.5 already proves that its distance set has positive Lebesgue measure, or the following construction is possible. After a similarity there are compact separated sets E1, E2 ⊂ E and probabilities µi supported on them, each satisfying µi(B(x, u)) ≤ CuS+χ for a fixed χ > 0. Their cross directions lie in a fixed arbitrarily small spherical patch. For every sufficiently small fixed ω > 0, there are decreasing Borel pair sets ΓN ⊂ E1 × E2 such that (1) (µ1 ⊗ µ2)( ⋂︁ N ΓN ) > 0; (2) ΓN is a disjoint union of at most C22dωN products of spatial Borel sets; (3) for every e > 0, there are c(e) > 0, Ce < ∞ and Borel BN ⊂ ΓN with (µ1 ⊗ µ2)(BN ) ≤ Ce2−c(e)N , such that for GN = ΓN \ BN , all 2−N ≤ u ≤ 1, and all spherical caps B(w, u), µ2{y : (x, y) ∈ GN , πx(y) ∈ B(w, u)} ≤ 2eN uS , µ1{x : (x, y) ∈ GN , πy(x) ∈ B(w, u)} ≤ 2eN uS . The last bounds integrate the original opposite marginal, without normalizing its individual fibers. The BN need not have a product partition or be nested. All constants are independent of N, but may depend on the fixed measures, ω, and e.
